standard-dialogue-at-port-sarim.npc: Jim's me name. Just 'avin a butcher's for anyone who wants some stuff done.

standard-dialogue-at-port-sarim.player: Oh, in the meat business are you?

standard-dialogue-at-port-sarim.npc: Whatchu' on about? I'm after bees 'n honey.

steps.player: Ah, I'm something of a farmer myself!

standard-dialogue-at-port-sarim.npc: Use yer loaf! Why'd I be in the tub fer that. I'm brassic ain't I!

standard-dialogue-at-port-sarim.player: Well, I have baked a loaf or two in my time as well.
I'm just trying to work out what you do.

standard-dialogue-at-port-sarim.npc: Well, then look at me boat and listen to wot's comin' out me gob!

standard-dialogue-at-port-sarim.text: If the player has not completed Pandemonium:

steps.player: I'm sorry, but I have no idea what you're trying to say to me. I'm just going to leave you to it.

steps.npc: Hmph! Suit yourself, guvna.

standard-dialogue-at-port-sarim.npc: There we go! Hmm... But tell you what, guvna... If yer in the salt yourself, maybe ye'd be wantin' a bit o' a hand on deck?

standard-dialogue-at-port-sarim.text: If the player does not have 40 Sailing:

steps.player: Thanks for the offer, but I'm still pretty new to it all. I don't think I'm ready to be hiring a crew yet, but I'll let you know when I am.

steps.npc: Hmph! Suit yourself, guvna.

steps.text: You need a Sailing level of 40 to manage a crew.

options.text: Sounds good to me. Why don't you join my crew?

steps.player: Sounds good to me. Why don't you join my crew?

steps.npc: Aye aye, guvna. Bound to make some sovs wiv you, ain't I?

options.text: Thanks for the offer, but I'm good at the moment.

options.text: Sounds good to me. Why don't you join my crew?

when-at-the-pandemonium.npc: 'ello, Cap'n! 'tis a fine nanny goat ya 'av.

when-at-the-pandemonium.player: I find it odd that I have an easier time understanding ghosts than you, Jim.

when-at-the-pandemonium.npc: There ain't an amulet that can contain me rabbit, Cap'n.

at-port-as-a-crew-member.npc: 'Ello, Cap'n! Anyfin' I can help yer with?

options.text: Can you help bank my cargo hold contents?

steps.text: If cargo hold is already empty:

steps.npc: Yer hold's already empty, Cap'n.

steps.text: If there are items in the cargo hold:

steps.prompt: Move all available items from your cargo hold to your bank?

steps.npc: Time to earn me shorts...

steps.text: Your crew start moving the contents of the cargo hold...

steps.npc: Yep, yer cargo hold's barren now. All's in yer' bank.

steps.text: If the bank doesn't have space:

steps.npc: Bank be a dead fiddle 'n all that. They didn't take anything from your cargo hold.
Could do with more dough, but can't complain 'bout conditions.

Been on me pins all day i 'ave.

at-sea-trimming-the-sails.npc: Trimmed those sails good and proper, Captain!
